## Status and authority

P1-W04 materializes adopted fictional records. The installed toolkit still refuses audits. JSON syntax, direct local references and transcription checks do not demonstrate ingestion, ancestry qualification, independence, corrective capacity or a computed report.

The controlling case text is `CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_AND_LINEAGE_SPEC.md` sections 24-28 and `VALIDATION_PLAN.md` sections 1-7, frozen by `PHASE_0_APPROVAL.md`. The input at preparation is repository commit `bfac2e69dd653823201a16069615cc9044a4b39c`, which contains accepted PR #4. Theory PDFs and later paper interpretations are not new fixture premises.

## Delivered cases

| File | Snapshot | Explicit source selection | Deliberate distinction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hero/H7-01.bundle.json` | H7-S1 | A-F / EA-EF | Six contributions; supplied acquisition grouping five to one |
| `hero/H7-V01.bundle.json` | H7-S-FIVE | A-E / EA-EE | Only seed lists change; F and its contradiction remain in the dossier |
| `hero/H7-V02.bundle.json` | H7-S-UNKNOWN | A-F,U / EA-EF,EU | U is a known Artifact; UX is the unresolved upstream EvidenceItem for C1 |
| `hero/H7-V03.bundle.json` | H7-S-MULTI | A-F,G / EA-EF,EG | EG has the two recorded parents EA and EF, with no allocation weights |

Each file is a complete independent snapshot with `predecessor = null`. No patch executor or predecessor traversal is required. Pipeline cohorts remain the explicitly six-member population. Correction targets remain R1-V1, A, D and E. The supplied O1/O2 process comparison keeps its own two-member scope.

The main input has 78 typed records, 50 assertions and eight supporting references. These are static inventory quantities, distinct from the six source contributions. The variants contain 78/50/8, 82/52/9 and 81/52/9 respectively. No count of serialized objects is an independent-source total.

## Mechanical expansion choices

All known times use the exact supplied instants. Unspecified optional fields are absent. Artifact publication/retrieval dates remain unknown with the specified reason; no publication times are fabricated. Native measurement and analytical-inference labels retain their modeled role in the fictional scenario. Every record retains explicit fictional provenance.

The eight original supporting excerpts are copied exactly from section 24.5. Supporting document records carry declaration provenance and point to their supplied excerpts. Documentary records retain the designated excerpt binding and limitation, while publisher roles retain their stated declaration basis. The self-attribution of the preparer supplies identity metadata without authenticating it.

Required descriptive strings whose exact spelling was not fixed are conservative transcriptions of the stated case meaning. The variant support excerpts expand only section 28.1's prescribed parentage and coverage supplement. They introduce no new collection, authority, correction or independent assessment.

The Artifact schema has no free `description` field. Section 27.3's descriptions of the three corrected/amended Artifacts are retained as qualified fictional descriptions in their CORR-bound provenance. No new core key, evidence reference or extra assertion is introduced. Record labels otherwise remain their IDs, as section 24.2 requires.

Structural nulls follow the subtype rules. The channel's withheld contact has its explicit Gap. The human review does not acquire an independence assessment. The unknown EE-use record remains `unknown` with `linkage_kind = unspecified`; it is not converted to `did_not_occur`.

The V02 complete old subview is explicit in H7-COV-ACQ-OLD. OB1 and OB2 point to it. The larger H7-COV-ACQ is partial and identifies EU/UX's gap. Its retained original support does not claim completion for that new branch. V03 retains complete scoped coverage and adds a supplied two-parent supplement, without reading prose as numerical weights.

## Verification and boundaries

`fixture_manifest.json` pins the four input files and four logical-oracle files, with SHA-256 over full UTF-8/LF bytes. It does not hash itself. These file identities detect transcription change and establish no real-world source truth.

The companion `../golden/` files contain test-only logical expectations. Production code must not load them. They contain no output generated by the toolkit. Changing an expected value to match a future implementation requires the existing reviewed case-change procedure.

`micro/case_index.json` indexes all 28 W7 cases with full section pointers. `adversarial/case_index.json` indexes 24 W9 controls, six licensing cases and 32 W11 realization cases, retaining the current WU11 refinements. These are indexes rather than implementations or claims that all cases passed. Existing W01 licensing history remains separate.

Run the new static test file from a full repository checkout:

```text
python -m unittest discover -s tests/scaffold -p test_fixture_integrity.py -v
```

It checks only static transcription, local reference inventory, exact prescribed variant changes, source-pointer integrity and logical oracle correspondence. It does not build a graph, calculate HHI, resolve ancestry, classify observability or execute a correction. The W02 and W03 test results and later hosted CI remain separate evidence.
